paragraphs: Chinena: R. Ammi bar Chinena; Rav Dimi bar Chinena; Rav Huna bar Chinena; Rav Chana bar Chinena; Ulla bar Chinena; Rav Ukva bar Chinena; Ravin bar Chinena. [Glosses: Chinena. (a) Makkot 21a: Rav Nachman son of Rav Ika. See the Tannaim and Amoraim section, letter chet, under Chinena: it is a scribal error and should read Chinena, since that is the reading of this matter in several places. It was not corrected. (b) Nedarim 28a: “Rav Chinena said: Rav Kahana said” should read “R. Chinena bar Kahana”; it was not corrected. I saw that matter in Bava Kamma 113a with R. Chinena bar Kahana and was pleased. (c) Eruvin 55b, near the end, has Rav Chinena bar Rav Kahana, while several places have bar Kahana; it was not corrected.]
